name: preview
title: Component preview
description: Pairs a live component example with a code view and a copy action.

props.name: controls
props.description: Optional controls shown with the live specimen.

props.name: actions
props.description: Optional actions beside the view switcher.

props.name: pattern
props.description: Controlled background. Without onPatternChange the background is fixed.

props.name: defaultPattern
props.description: Initial background for an uncontrolled preview.

props.name: onCopyResult
props.description: Reports the source copy outcome without coupling the registry to analytics.
